name: Mud cracks 12: grid city
description: City streets on the simulation grid's own axes, the way it favours, with less smoothing, so it helps keep them straight: dead-straight avenues, cross streets at right angles ending in T-junctions, rectangular blocks that keep flat sides. Starts part dried, just before the first streets. Paint district above a half for neighbourhoods on the diagonals instead, straight, square, cross_lag, grow, dry, grip or toughness.
